title: Akber ne ye sheh se kaha dam toot raha hai
body:
Akber ne ye sheh se kaha dam toot raha hai
Hat jaaiye baba mera dam toot raha hai
Juz sabr ke chaarah nahi aye qibla o kaaba
ab rone se kya faaeda dam toot raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehre pa mere mout ka aaya hai pasina
bas ho chuka ab qaatema dam toot raha hai
baba mere jeene se utha leejiye ab aas
seene se lahu beh gaya dam toot raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Barchi ki ani reh gayi hai seene me mere
dam toot raha hai mera dam toot raha hai
Atthaara baras paalne waali se na kehna
ran me tere farzand ka dam toot raha hai
